definitions.gloss: straightforward, direct, concise, to the point
definitions.explanation: Describes expressing something clearly and directly without beating around the bush. Used for speech, writing, and descriptions that get straight to the essential point.

examples.japanese: {端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧だ。
examples.english: To put it bluntly, it was a failure.

examples.japanese: {端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べて→述べる：02389_noberu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本質|ほんしつ}→本質：04810_honshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表|あらわ}している→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: This single remark concisely captures the essence of the problem.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a na-adjective ({端的|たんてき}な) and is very commonly used as an adverb with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say directly). This is a somewhat formal word used when someone wants to cut through complexity and state things plainly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to put it simply/directly
- {端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: to put it bluntly
- {端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express concisely
- {端的|たんてき}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: a concise expression
- {端的|たんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show directly
